checks.title: Confirm funnel question and owner
checks.instructions: Name the SaaS product, tenant, eligible signup cohort, commercial goal, decision owner and excluded populations. Decide whether the first result is a comparison or baseline-first observation.

checks.title: Freeze ordered stage definitions
checks.instructions: Record eligible, signup, activated and paid states with event or billing source, event version, time ordering, deduplication rule and timezone. A trial or checkout click is not paid state.

checks.title: Confirm identity and coverage
checks.instructions: Probe the join from event user/account ID to billing customer/subscription. Record source revisions, consent, internal/test exclusions, matched and unmatched counts, billing lag and latest paid-state cutoff.

checks.title: Set comparison or baseline-first rules
checks.instructions: Choose equal baseline/current windows with the same population, filters and event versions, or one complete current window explicitly marked baseline-first. Define stage denominators, minimum coverage, freshness, small-sample rule and how changed instrumentation starts a new baseline.

checks.title: Bind two distinct Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect and reuse or create authorized Funnel Analyst and Growth Experiment Planner Crew IDs with selected skills and separate output paths. One Crew identity cannot satisfy both required slots.

checks.title: Probe both Crew inputs
checks.instructions: Have Funnel Analyst read one representative event and exact paid-state record or export. Have Growth Experiment Planner read the validated observation and owner policy. Save stable IDs, scopes, observed times and missing access.

checks.title: Validate the stage-count handoff
checks.instructions: Save funnel-observation/v1 and run the blocking validator. Pass its exact ID to the planner, save funnel-experiment-plan/v1 and validate both. Record run IDs, paths, validation output and a rejected false-launch case.

checks.title: Review the Builder proposal
checks.instructions: Show Crew reuse/creation, source access, event and identity rules, handoff validator, metric/guardrail, owner approval boundary, sample and cost policy. Playbook selection does not authorize a query, experiment or change.

checks.title: Run one bounded funnel case
checks.instructions: Use two authorized comparable exports or a baseline-first case. Recompute stage counts and rates, check paid-state evidence and identity coverage, then have the owner review a pending experiment proposal. Keep the route manual if source or validation is missing.

checks.title: Choose monitoring policy
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed paused schedule with timezone, source freshness, billing lag, query cost, deduplication, retries and notifications. Completing this check does not launch an experiment or enable recurrence.
